title: EBSD Pattern Center Fitting with Particle Swarm Optimization
content: Electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD) and closely related transmission Kikuchi diffraction (TKD) continue to be critical tools for the analysis of microstructures. However, the correct indexing and orientation determination of the Kikuchi patterns require an accurate measurement of geometrical relationship between the sample and detector. This is most often expressed as the vector that is perpendicular to the plane of the detector face and passes through the point at the sample surface where the channeling electrons are being emitted and is commonly referred to as the pattern center (PC).
